baseline_adjustment: Direct chunk reverse iteration is enabled in both variants.
post_measurement_note: Historical baseline and indexed-only trials retained from the previous comparison. Both selected variants loaded the baseline SMT module. After measurement, map serialization was fixed and unused SMT-specific dictionary materialization support was removed. These timings have not been rerun for that cleanup.

protocol.verification: Six runs per case and variant; sequential fresh processes; rotating variant order; SMT caches cleared and garbage collected before timing; collection and parsing excluded; GC remains enabled.
protocol.synthesis: Lazy TDSyn enumerative; 3 seeds (0,1,2); 20-second cooperative budgets per run; sequential fresh processes and rotating variant order. Full validation, runtime requirements and objective evaluation remain enabled. Parsing excluded.
protocol.containers: Three repetitions; 256 child scopes; timing excludes parent construction; peak traced Python allocation measured in a separate pass with children retained. These are container operations, not full solver execution.

limitations: Only lazy TDSyn enumerative is benchmarked end-to-end; other solvers share these contexts but may see different gains.
Short cooperative budgets may overrun while finishing a candidate; throughput uses measured synthesis wall time.
Container microbenchmark speedups and allocation savings must not be interpreted as whole-program or process-RSS improvements.
Indexed typing contexts trade additional allocation for faster lookup.
